text:
morgan: Quick heads-up — PR #8122 looks like it introduced a small-batch memory drift. Microbench for batch_size <= 4 reports ~+120MB p95 on 4k longseqs. Need a 2nd opinion and if confirmed we should decide revert vs hotfix and timing for the merge window. :eyes:

alisa: ugh, ok. can you paste the bench command + results? also which model config (quant/kv-shard)?

morgan: bench run: `./bench/run_small_batch.py --model rdx-4k --quant=4bit --seq=4096 --batch-sizes 1,2,4 --runs 50`

Results (summary):
```
batch=1  p50=220MB  p95=340MB  p99=360MB
batch=2  p50=230MB  p95=360MB  p99=380MB
batch=4  p50=260MB  p95=460MB  p99=480MB    <-- +120MB vs baseline
baseline (main) batch=4 p95=340MB
```

Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/artifacts/4590012345 (bench logs + flamegraphs)

ben: do we know if this is allocator config drift (tcmalloc vs new-slab) or a KV cache retention change? any obvious alloc traces in the flamegraph?

morgan: flamegraph shows a bigger hot path in `kv_shard::prefill` for small batches — looks like some extra memcpy introduced in PR diff where we prefetch a padded tile. not obvious leak, more regressive working set.

ryan: ran a quick canary on ded. Canary traffic p95 OK but infra-side memory p95 aligns with your bench. no OOMs but higher mem reservation on small-batch tail.

dev-bot: CI: perf-bench job finished — status: flaky-ok. Artifacts uploaded to https://ci.redwood/bench/artifacts/4590012345. Compare report: main -> PR diff: +35% p95 mem for small-batch workloads.

alisa: I can give a fast review. if it's prefetch padding, maybe reduce padding or gate it behind an env flag for canary. do we have a minimal diff to revert?

ben: Minimal revert is just dropping the padding change in allocator_util.cc (5-line). But that change also fixed a corner-case for multi-shard prefetch ordering. need 2nd approval to merge revert.

morgan: I'll open a revert PR (revert-pr-8122-hotfix) now and attach the bench. Requesting two approvals for a hotfix revert and merge slot today if possible — this is impacting a production pathway for small-batch real-time customers.

ryan: +1 to revert. schedule for next merge window (10:30 PST). I can take post-merge canary and watch mem graphs.

alisa: +1, leaving a quick comment on revert PR with suggestion to gate padding behind `RDW_PREFETCH_PAD` env var as a follow-up.

ben: before merge, can we sanity-run `NUM_THREADS=2` microbench? last time padding only surfaced with low thread counts.

morgan: running now with NUM_THREADS=2, will paste short results in a sec.

morgan: quick NUM_THREADS=2 run (same bench):
```
batch=4  p95=445MB  p99=470MB
baseline (main) batch=4 p95=335MB
```

morgan: ok that's consistent. i'll open the revert PR and request approvals. tagging @engineering-leads for merge window alignment. :pray:

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Revert PR created: https://ci.redwood/pr/8122-revert-hotfix. CI: unit tests ok, perf checks attached.

ryan: Good. If no objections from infra, revert + small gated re-work afterwards. I'll monitor post-merge canary and roll back if any spike.

morgan: thanks all — pinging again in #eng-runtime if merge slot confirmed.
